name: Server and Workplaces
description: The local 127.0.0.1 HTTP entry point plus the workplace manager and Trident-wide settings store that wire each workplace's board, Lead, team and compare node together.

name: Agent Orchestration
description: The Lead agent session, the cross-vendor worker team that builds in git worktrees and cross-checks work, the side-by-side compare node, and the approval gate that holds risky tool calls for the user.

name: Model Providers
description: Adapters that turn the Claude Agent SDK, the long-lived Codex app-server and the OpenRouter route into message-at-a-time worker sessions.

name: Agent Tool Servers
description: In-process MCP servers that give agents board actions (plans, tasks, assignment), team-talk messaging and Library read/write tools.

name: Storage and Workspace State
description: Persistent state behind the agents: the SQLite board of goals, tasks and talk, the draft-then-approve Markdown Library folder, and git worktree plumbing for worker workspaces.

name: Web Interface
description: The single-page Trident UI (workplaces sidebar, Lead chat, approvals bar, task board, Library and Settings) styled by the Ember design-system stylesheet.

name: Spikes and Probes
description: Standalone experiment and check scripts that confirm SDK logins, Codex app-server behaviour, OpenRouter keys and models, timing, and an end-to-end team run against the live server.

name: Docs and Configuration
description: The README, the design document and agent-collaboration teardown, plus the npm manifest, Claude Code launch config and tooling settings that start and describe Trident.
